title: B2AGI Physical AI 2027: Institutions 50
selection_type: contribution-based selection; record IDs are not ranks

records.name: ARM Institute
records.selection_rationale: ARM Institute helped Keystone Ridge move from evaluation and proof of concept through an RFP to installation of a robot cell.
records.evidence_scope: Institute case with customer quotations; evidence concerns the named adoption pathway.

records.name: ASTM F45
records.selection_rationale: ASTM F45 provides performance-test standards for unmanned mobile tasks, with NIST documenting the technical basis of its first four standards.
records.evidence_scope: NIST’s 2018 record documents publication of ASTM F45’s first four mobile-task performance standards.

records.name: Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
records.selection_rationale: Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center co-developed RoboMIND, with government material naming external institutions using it for training.
records.evidence_scope: Government development and use report; download counts and unique users are distinct measures, with independent use verification limited.

records.name: BIGAI
records.selection_rationale: BIGAI co-authored RoboVerse, with RLinf documenting its integration into research workflows.
records.evidence_scope: Named institutional co-authors and external integration account, with partner institutions and existing simulators sharing the contribution.

records.name: CESI
records.selection_rationale: CESI is a joint drafting organization for GB/Z 218.1-2026, guidance on real-data quality for embodied intelligence, published on 27 August 2026.
records.evidence_scope: The official record classifies the document as technical guidance and lists CESI among its drafters. TC28 has committee responsibility, TC28SC42 is the executing body, and SAC is the supervisory authority.

records.name: CMU Robotics Institute
records.selection_rationale: CMU’s Robotics Institute supports robotics research and education. Its NREC partnered with Carnegie Robotics to commercialize robotic components and systems.
records.evidence_scope: CMU’s 2010 partnership record documents NREC technology transfer to Carnegie Robotics; NREC remains within the institute’s activity record.

records.name: DARPA SubT
records.selection_rationale: DARPA’s SubT competition provided shared physical test environments and tasks used by teams including CSIRO Data61, Emesent and Georgia Tech.
records.evidence_scope: Participant account of the competition ending in 2021; team-developed robots and autonomy retain separate attribution.

records.name: DFKI Robotics Innovation Center
records.selection_rationale: DFKI’s Robotics Innovation Center participated in TransFit research with Bremen and Siemens, producing joint research outputs.
records.evidence_scope: The 2017 to 2021 TransFit record covers German research collaboration and published outputs.

records.name: ETRI
records.selection_rationale: ETRI transferred FMS to Twinny and supported recipient-specific joint development through staff working at the company.
records.evidence_scope: ETRI Webzine Vol.225 documents FMS transfer to Twinny, on-site staff support and joint software adaptation for people working alongside robots.

records.name: euRobotics
records.selection_rationale: CORDIS records euRobotics’ coordination of RockEU2 and the launch and operation of two ERL seasons.
records.evidence_scope: Completed project and competition records; market forecasts retain forecast status.

records.name: FAA
records.selection_rationale: The FAA authorized Zipline to deliver commercial packages beyond visual line of sight in 2023, establishing a defined regulatory route for the operator.
records.evidence_scope: The FAA’s 2023 authorization covers Zipline commercial-package delivery beyond visual line of sight under the specified approval scope.

records.name: Harvard Wyss Institute
records.selection_rationale: Harvard Wyss and SEAS researchers developed personalized soft-exosuit assistance from muscle ultrasound and tested it across walking speeds and inclines. Wyss also records technology licensing to ReWalk.
records.evidence_scope: Harvard’s November 2021 account documents joint Wyss and SEAS research and walking tests. The ReWalk licensing record covers a separate technology-transfer activity.

records.name: HIT Robotics Technology and Systems Research Unit
records.selection_rationale: HIT’s robotics technology and systems research unit supported a learning-method project through resources, supervision and physical-robot experiments.
records.evidence_scope: Project acknowledgments, resource and supervision records, and physical experiments describe the research unit’s support; authors retain algorithm credit.

records.name: HKEX / HKSCC
records.selection_rationale: HKEX and HKSCC provided listing and clearing access used by UBTECH, whose listing began on 2023-12-29.
records.evidence_scope: Issuer listing confirmation and clearing notice; the notice supplies no actual fundraising amount.

records.name: IEC Robotics Product Safety Standards
records.selection_rationale: IEC robotics-product safety work provides a lawn-robot standard edition cited in a manufacturer’s conformity declaration.
records.evidence_scope: Standard edition and manufacturer declaration; the declaration and an IEC-issued product certificate have different status.

records.name: IFR
records.selection_rationale: IFR provides recurring robot statistics and definitions through a documented collection and publication structure.
records.evidence_scope: Industrial and service robotics statistics; coverage differs from the full Physical AI sector and company rankings.

records.name: ISO/TC 299
records.selection_rationale: ISO/TC 299 develops shared robotics standards through published outputs, participating countries and industrial organizations.
records.evidence_scope: Committee and publication records distinguish published standards from standards under development.

records.name: KAIST
records.selection_rationale: KAIST’s HUBO platform supports outside research and education. Drexel describes using HUBO Lab hardware and student software in performances and joint research.
records.evidence_scope: External-user account; university, laboratory and center contributions remain within one institutional record.

records.name: KEIT
records.selection_rationale: KEIT supported humanoid balance-recovery research whose paper identifies the funded project and partial support.
records.evidence_scope: 2011 paper acknowledgment; KEIT’s funding and management role is distinct from the researchers’ algorithms and experiments.

records.name: KIAT
records.selection_rationale: KIAT funded project P0014166, whose researchers reported implementation and experiments on a robotics safety testbed.
records.evidence_scope: Completed paper and funding acknowledgment; KIAT provided support while KIRIA researchers implemented and tested the system.

records.name: KIRIA
records.selection_rationale: KIRIA issued KS certification for a wearable-robot product, confirmed in Hyundai’s announcement.
records.evidence_scope: Hyundai's announcement identifies KIRIA's KS certification of the specified non-powered wearable product.

records.name: KITECH
records.selection_rationale: KITECH researchers connected a physical robot with Isaac Sim and compared forward motion, turning and LiDAR messages.
records.evidence_scope: Completed digital-twin implementation research; automated learning parameters and quantitative network-loss evaluation remain future tasks.

records.name: KRX
records.selection_rationale: KRX provided KOSPI listing and trading access for Doosan Robotics, documented by the issuer’s completed listing and contract records.
records.evidence_scope: Issuer listing records; subscription deposits and bookbuilding demand have separate scope from newly received issuer funds.

records.name: KTL
records.selection_rationale: KTL provided testing used by Dari Technology, whose history records wearable-robot IP55, payload and weight test reports.
records.evidence_scope: Recipient’s test-report history; evidence concerns these specific external tests.

records.name: LeRobot / Hugging Face
records.selection_rationale: LeRobot provides public code and data formats integrated into an external Trossen hardware workflow.
records.evidence_scope: Project resources and experimental external documentation with version constraints; repository popularity has a different scope from active deployments.

records.name: MassRobotics
records.selection_rationale: MassRobotics operates shared development space and experimental resources for named resident companies.
records.evidence_scope: Resident and program records; the residency program provides access and states that it supplies no direct funding or equity investment.

records.name: MIIT
records.selection_rationale: MIIT jointly implemented selection and dissemination of 2024 mining-robot applications under the Robot+ plan.
records.evidence_scope: The final application-selection notice records joint policy implementation with the mining-safety authority.

records.name: MIT CSAIL
records.selection_rationale: MIT CSAIL conducted gesture-control research connecting EMG, learning and physical-drone experiments, with partial Boeing support.
records.evidence_scope: Joint DelPreto and Rus research; Boeing’s role is funding, and Parrot retains drone-hardware credit.

records.name: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory
records.selection_rationale: JPL built and operated a Mars rover whose records describe autonomous perception, planning and physical driving.
records.evidence_scope: Official account accompanying an animation of 2023-07-15 drive data; destination setting and ground-team planning remain part of operations.

records.name: Nasdaq
records.selection_rationale: Nasdaq provided public-market access for Serve through a completed share offering and Nasdaq Capital Market trading.
records.evidence_scope: 2024 issuer record; USD 40 million is gross offering proceeds before costs, and the overallotment option has separate execution status.

records.name: National Robot Testing and Evaluation Center, Shanghai Headquarters
records.selection_rationale: The National Robot Testing and Evaluation Center's Shanghai headquarters issued CR certification for AgiBot Genie G2 through Shanghai Robot Industry Technology Research Institute.
records.evidence_scope: The July 2026 report names the Shanghai implementing carrier; the platform page separately identifies Shanghai Electrical Apparatus Research Institute (Group) Co., Ltd. as the headquarters construction unit.

records.name: New York Stock Exchange / NYSE
records.selection_rationale: NYSE provided historical trading access for Ouster, recorded in the issuer’s 2021 annual report.
records.evidence_scope: Historical issuer filing; Ouster’s announced December 2024 transfer to Nasdaq is a separate event.

records.name: NHTSA
records.selection_rationale: NHTSA provides public safety-recall reporting, including Waymo's manufacturer-submitted report on an automated-driving flooding hazard.
records.evidence_scope: Recall 26E026, submitted May 6, 2026, records interim operating restrictions and a final remedy under development at filing.

sources.title: Waymo safety recall 26E026
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1-3: equipment, defect, chronology and remedy; submitted 2026-05-06

records.name: NIOSH / Center for Occupational Robotics Research
records.role: Occupational robotics hazard research and guidance
records.selection_rationale: NIOSH contributed to joint workplace-robotics guidance and published fatality and nonfatal-injury research relevant to worker protection.
records.evidence_scope: Joint guidance credits A3 engineers and NIOSH researchers. The 2023 fatality study covers 1992-2017; the 2026 NIOSH/Ohio study analyzes 1,076 claims from 2001-2020 and credits Ohio's data provision and the joint research team.

records.name: NIST
records.selection_rationale: NIST develops robot mobility measurements, tests and standards through an actual measurement program.
records.evidence_scope: Specific robotics measurement outputs; safety certification and the wider AI RMF are separate functions.

records.name: Open Robotics / OSRF
records.selection_rationale: The nonprofit OSRF provides and maintains open software used in robotics research and product development under the Open Robotics brand.
records.evidence_scope: Organizational and software records; sold OSRC businesses and Intrinsic revenue retain separate legal and commercial scope.

records.name: Open X-Embodiment consortium
records.selection_rationale: Open X-Embodiment provides shared data formats and RT-X models used by multiple laboratories in physical-robot evaluations.
records.evidence_scope: Named consortium research; participation counts vary by edition and rights differ across datasets.

records.name: OSHA Robotics Safety Guidance
records.selection_rationale: OSHA provides an updated robotics safety technical manual for inspectors and workplace safety staff.
records.evidence_scope: 2022 joint-guidance announcement; A3 engineering and NIOSH research retain separate contributions, with field inspection effects unmeasured.

records.name: POSTECH
records.selection_rationale: POSTECH's Keehoon Kim and Jaewon Byun co-developed hospital disinfection robotics with KIST, KIRO, Elphoton and Pohang St. Mary's Hospital.
records.evidence_scope: Institution-reported wiping and UV-C research and hospital evaluation; KIST's Sang-Rok Oh is named project director, and KIRO researchers retain joint credit.

sources.title: POSTECH: hospital disinfection robotics
sources.locator: Collaborators, hospital evaluation and final funding/project-director paragraph

sources.title: POSTECH MARCH: joint research publication notice

records.name: RAI Institute
records.selection_rationale: RAI Institute published learning code, Spot deployment methods and MIT-licensed research resources applied to Spot and Atlas hardware.
records.evidence_scope: Published learning code and hardware methods for Spot and Atlas. The repository README identifies its maintenance status as inactive.

records.name: SAC
records.selection_rationale: SAC is the supervisory authority for GB/Z 218.1-2026, the technical guidance document on real-data quality for embodied intelligence published on 27 August 2026.
records.evidence_scope: The official record identifies TC28 committee responsibility and TC28SC42 execution. CESI and the other listed organizations share drafting credit; SAC’s supervisory role is separate.

records.name: SEC
records.selection_rationale: The SEC reviewed Serve disclosures, including questions about funding constraints and deployment outlook.
records.evidence_scope: Actual review correspondence; filing effectiveness, secondary share sales and new proceeds retain separate regulatory and financial meanings.

records.name: Shanghai AI Lab
records.selection_rationale: Shanghai AI Lab’s InternUtopia was used for simulation evaluation by the named external EA-Nav research team.
records.evidence_scope: External paper reporting use; public code and downloads have separate scope from physical commercial operations.

records.name: Shanghai Stock Exchange
records.selection_rationale: Shanghai Stock Exchange provided market access for welding-robot issuer Kaierda, with trading beginning on 2021-10-25 under 688255.
records.evidence_scope: Official listing notice; the exchange provides a market channel, while company proceeds and revenues retain issuer-level scope.

records.name: Shenzhen Stock Exchange
records.selection_rationale: Shenzhen Stock Exchange provided listing and new-share fundraising access for industrial automation issuer Estun under 002747.
records.evidence_scope: Official issuer-market announcement; the exchange is a market channel, with company-wide proceeds and revenues retaining their own scope.

records.name: SIA
records.selection_rationale: SIA supported industrial-robot technology transfer through research-team commercialization and Siasun's formation.
records.evidence_scope: The SIA-hosted historical account documents team and core-technology transfer. The Shenyang/Liaoning testing website identifies a separate location within the national testing network.

sources.title: SIA: industrial technology transfer retrospective
sources.locator: Siasun formation and research-team/core-technology transfer paragraphs

sources.title: Shenyang/Liaoning robot testing centers
sources.locator: Center labels, Shenyang address and SIA footer

records.name: Toyota Research Institute
records.selection_rationale: Toyota Research Institute co-developed and supported Drake and provided manipulation research and public benchmarks used in robotics work.
records.evidence_scope: Development, research and benchmark-use records; Toyota manufacturing results and TRI research retain separate scope.

records.name: UC Berkeley BAIR: RAIL BridgeData
records.role: Shared robot data and training tools
records.selection_rationale: Berkeley RAIL’s BridgeData provides shared robot data, training code and access conditions used through documented external data-format workflows.
records.evidence_scope: Evidence covers the RAIL activity within BAIR; shared Open X-Embodiment data events are cross-referenced without duplicate counting.

records.name: XbotPark
records.selection_rationale: XbotPark provided startup funding support to Narwal, as described alongside direction-finding assistance in HKCRC material.
records.evidence_scope: HKCRC’s account describes XbotPark funding support to Narwal, whose products and operating results retain company attribution.

records.name: Zhejiang University Robotics Research
records.selection_rationale: Zhejiang University provided robotics education using two Jueying robots brought by project leader Zhu Qiuguo for a completed course in September 2021.
records.evidence_scope: EDP course record dated 2021-09-25 to 2021-09-26; evidence covers demonstration and interaction, with learning effects unmeasured.
